datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2012 in Somalia. Geographic boundaries and classification phases were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing spatial distribution of acute food insecurity conditions across administrative units.
